name: Combinatorial Sequence Obfuscation
description: Replaces the original binomial parity condition with a sequence arrangement counting problem. Models must analyze the valid permutations of a multiset (of size 2, 3, or 4) to discover that the condition is only satisfied when the two tiers are different. This prevents surface-level pattern matching to bipartiteness without using arithmetic modulo or division that could cause solver drift.
